prose: I recently had a fun hang with Reality Designers, riffing on topics such as staying tuned and awake in a world that's going crazier by the day, how what we see on the external is a reflection of our Internal State, and even some bits about modern gnosticism and the flaws and debunks in the code of these ideas we have collectively recognized and why we see reality differently. We also talked about Reality being a type of Video Game, and what that means for our soul's evolution and whether to take life too seriously or not, if it were just a game after all.
